items.title: Jay Leonhart interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I find I’m really influenced by Oscar Pettiford, the melodicness

ctx.x: Well it sure showed me what that bass instrument could be about. The sound, the drive, the beauty, it just overwhelmed me. And so I listened and listened. And to this day the way — the sound that Ray Brown got on that record, is to me the way I want the bass to sound. And sometimes I accuse myself, well why don’t you become an original — why don’t you do — and in many ways I’m very original. I write my own songs, I do a lot of things, I don’t play the same notes that Ray plays, but boy I’m telling you, the spirit…
Melodiousness. That’s worse. We know what you mean.
